# Booking.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/bookingcom-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/bookingcom-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects hotel data from booking.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Booking.com (2025 Update)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-bookingcom)
- **Code:** [`bookingcom.py`](bookingcom.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Hotel pages](results/hotel.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json) · [Hotel review](results/hotel_review.json)

## What it scrapes

- Booking.com search for finding hotels from search queries.
- Booking.com hotel listing details:
    - hotel info: description, rating, features etc.
    - prices
- Booking.com hotel review data

## Functions

- `scrape_search(query, checkin='', checkout='', number_of_rooms=1, max_pages=None)` → `List[Dict]`: Scrape booking.com search
- `scrape_hotel(url, checkin, price_n_days=61)` → `Hotel`: Scrape Booking.com hotel data and pricing information.
- `scrape_hotel_reviews(url, max_pages=None)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape hotel review data

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import bookingcom


async def main():
    hotel_reviews = await bookingcom.scrape_hotel_reviews(
        "https://www.booking.com/hotel/gb/gardencourthotel.en-gb.html",
        max_pages=3,
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`Location`**: `b_max_los_data`, `b_show_entire_homes_checkbox`, `cc1`, `cjk`, `dest_id`, `dest_type`, `label`, `label1`, `label2`, `labels`, `latitude`, `lc`, `longitude`, `nr_homes`, `nr_hotels`, `nr_hotels_25`, `photo_uri`, `roundtrip`, `rtl`, `value`
- **`LocationSuggestions`**: `results`
- **`PriceData`**: `checkin`, `min_length_of_stay`, `avg_price_pretty`, `available`, `avg_price_raw`, `length_of_stay`, `price_pretty`, `price`
- **`Hotel`**: `url`, `id`, `description`, `address`, `images`, `lat`, `lng`, `features`, `price`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`bookingcom.py`](bookingcom.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), its anti-bot bypass
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy

## Notes

Booking.com can be difficult to scrape because of scraper blocking so this scraper is using Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker) feature (previously Anti Scraping Protection).

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/bookingcom-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_search_scraping`, `test_hotel_scraping`, `test_hotel_reviews_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
